items.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
items.why: Quote confirms OAuth access tokens only; no api_key or basic, no deprecation.

items.quote: Basic authentication is used for API tokens.
items.why: Confirms Basic auth for API tokens; omits oauth2, api_key, and deprecated label.

items.quote: If you plan on making an app, integration, or bot available to multiple Zendesk customers, you must use global OAuth access tokens to authenticate Zendesk API requests.
items.why: Confirms global OAuth for multi-customer apps; only one detail of the auth-method claim.

items.quote: Try out the Sunshine Platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
items.why: Free 14-day trial account directly states the self-serve trial gate.
No credit card needed is consistent with the claim but doesn't state a trial.

items.quote: You can use the Support API with tickets, users, organizations, custom objects, and manage ticket workflows.
items.why: Covers Support API only; the claim's other REST families and breadth are unsupported.

items.quote: Try out the Sunshine Platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
items.why: Quote is the free trial sentence; says nothing about an MCP server.
